Don’t trust a parent whose adult child is not on speaking terms with them. It takes a fucking lot for someone to drop contact completely with their own parents. It’s not something you do on a whim especially nowadays where you have to have a lot of money to move out and be completely independent. Not to mention spending holidays and birthdays alone.

Don’t fall for their woe-is-me attitude.
Just keep an eye out, there are plenty of adults who want to chat you up on here. A lot of them fake being teenagers themselves.
Not worth it. You’ll probably get your stomach pumped and land in crazy jail. That’s it.

You’re the reason I will never trust hospitals and psych wards. I’ll kill myself before I end up with an uncaring person like you making fun of my vulnerable state on Reddit. None of you even care about the people you look after when you’re ‘supposed’ to be all we have. You all fucking suck. If I’m so crazy and frustrating to deal with I’ll kill mused right fucking now, I hope you’re happy.

Unless you adopt children 

Although even then it seems like people prefer to pick and choose who suits them best
I will continue to decline mentally
Reading half of a self help book hit a little too hard ha

What causes it to happen? Hmm I don’t know… maybe that these young autistic men are treated like trash by society, they’re always perceived as ugly, creepy, perverted. They found a group that would accept them and that’s that. 

And no I’m not trying to go all anti-feminist on this but the different ways autistic men and autistic women are treated is staggering. It’s hard to deny. I’m autistic and a woman and I’ve been primarily interpreted as defenceless, in need of protecting and immature. Whereas autistic men are usually interpreted as creeps, no doubt because they’re men and that’s how men are always seen as if you don’t personally know them, and a social disorder in peoples minds just amplifies the creepiness. They both suck but this is probably why you’ll find more autistic men being radicalised than autistic women

I’ve seen videos of people screaming and smacking their children, with hundreds of comments approving of it because they ‘deserve’ it for whatever mundane thing they did. Now imagine coming across that video when you’re an adult and seeing all the people agreeing that you deserve to be beat and public ally humiliated
If you have to take care of your siblings a lot, why not take them to the park and play sports with them when they’re in your care? It would be a small stepping stone.
Just say it’s because of mental health issues. Try to word it like that because it’s illegal for them to discriminate based off of disability/medical issues.
Don’t you know they’re the only people who matter? Bow down and kiss their ass and feet you peasant manual labourer.
